(Japanese: '''霊獣フォルム総進撃！イッシュ最大の危機！！''' ''The {{tt|Reijuu|Therian}} Formes Advance! {{tt|Isshu|Unova}}'s Greatest Crisis!!'') is the 97th episode of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'', and the 754th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on October 4, 2012, in the United Kingdom on December 31, 2012 and in the United States on January 26, 2013. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Team Rocket has captured Meloetta, brought it to the Undersea Temple, and used a recording of Meloetta's song to raise the temple to the surface. As Operation Tempest continues, Giovanni acquires the mysterious Reveal Glass and uses it to summon the three Legendary Pokémon Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus! Meloetta's protector, Ridley, explains that whoever controls Meloetta also controls these three ancient powers. Team Rocket’s plan is just the latest attempt by evildoers over the years to take over the Unova region using the power of the Reveal Glass. Our heroes watch in horror as the three Legendary Pokémon change into Therian Forme and prepare to wreak havoc upon Unova! As Ash and Pikachu escape from their cage, an enormous Pokémon battle takes shape: Iris's Dragonite, Cilan's Pansage, Cynthia's Garchomp, Ridley's Golurk, and Ash's Unfezant join with Pikachu to stand against the fearsome Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus. A crackling attack from Thundurus almost strikes Iris down, but Pikachu flings itself into the bolt's path to protect her. Using the extra electricity it absorbed from that attack, Pikachu launches a massive Electro Ball to overpower Team Rocket and free Meloetta! But Giovanni still holds the Reveal Glass, and without Meloetta's calming influence, he is completely overcome with evil ambitions: instead of conquering the Unova region, he now wants to destroy it! But Jessie, James, and Meowth intervene to sway their Boss from this disastrous path. As soon as he returns to his senses, Team Rocket reluctantly retreats. Ridley uses the Reveal Glass to return the three Legendary Pokémon to their Incarnate Forme, and Meloetta soothes their rage with its song. With disaster averted, Ridley and Meloetta bid our heroes farewell and prepare to return to home. But Ash knows they will meet again someday, and all eyes once again turn toward the Unova League! ==Plot== Continuing from where [[BW096|the previous episode]] left off, {{an|Giovanni}} has raised the [[Abyssal Ruins]] using {{an|Meloetta}}'s song, bringing [[Team Rocket]]'s Operation Tempest to its final phase. {{Ash}} and {{AP|Pikachu}} are still trapped in a containment cube at the temple, unable to do anything to stop Team Rocket. Giovanni orders the [[Reveal Glass]] to summon the three great powers, and in response, it emits a ray that begins forming a storm in the sky. Meanwhile, [[Jervis]] escorts {{an|Cynthia}}, [[Ridley]] and {{ashfr|Ash's friends}} across [[Undella Bay]] to reach the ruins. Ridley suffers physical pain as a result of Team Rocket harming Meloetta. He relates the story of the ruins to the others: long ago, an ancient society living there used the Reveal Glass to control the {{an|forces of nature}} with wisdom, but people soon grew corrupt and began fighting to use the Reveal Glass for their own selfish ends. Meloetta, seeing the destruction being wrought by the conflict over the Reveal Glass, sealed it away by sinking the Abyssal Ruins to the bottom of the ocean. The seas grow rougher as Ridley warns that Team Rocket plan to use Meloetta to control the forces of nature, giving them the ability to rule [[Unova]]. Three portals open in the sky over the Abyssal Ruins. Ridley recognizes the forces of nature as they descend, identifying them as {{p|Tornadus}}, {{p|Thundurus}}, and {{p|Landorus}}. Once all three have fully emerged, Giovanni welcomes them and urges the Reveal Glass to turn them into their "other form." As this happens, Ash cannot sit still any longer. He tells Pikachu to try breaking out of the cube once again, by focusing {{m|Iron Tail}} on a single point. This soon breaks the cube, and Ash scales the temple to try and save Meloetta, but [[Jessie]] and [[James]] send {{TP|Jessie|Woobat}} and {{TP|James|Yamask}} to stop him. They blow him and Pikachu off the temple with {{m|Air Slash}} and {{m|Shadow Ball}}, but the pair are saved by Ridley's {{p|Golurk}}. Ash and Pikachu reunite with the others at the base of the temple. Resolving to stop Team Rocket's plans, they assemble a group of their Pokémon: {{TP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}, {{TP|Iris|Dragonite}}, {{TP|Cilan|Pansage}} and {{AP|Unfezant}} with Pikachu accompanying them. Dragonite flies off without orders from {{an|Iris}}, leaving the others to follow, but the entire group are soon pushed back by a burst of red light from the Reveal Glass. Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus transform into their Therian Formes, and as the light recedes, it briefly surrounds Giovanni's body and fills his eyes as well. Taking control of the ruins' power, Giovanni orders the forces of nature into battle. Dragonite recklessly takes on the [[Legendary Pokémon]] ahead of the others, against Iris's pleas. Tornadus and Landorus easily overwhelm Dragonite using {{m|Air Slash}} and {{m|Stone Edge}}, sending him crashing back to the base of the temple. While he is stunned, Thundurus descends and prepares an immense electrical attack to finish him off. Iris steps in front of the attack to protect him, but then Pikachu jumps in the way to protect her, absorbing the elctricity from the blast. Iris's act helps her finally begin to connect with Dragonite, and he starts to display a newfound sense of trust in her. He rejoins the battle alongside the others, but they fail to make much headway against the forces of nature. Giovanni commands the forces of nature to unleash their true power, causing Meloetta to scream out in pain as the Reveal Glass empowers them further. The eyes of the forces of nature become fully red, and they knock all of their opponents into the ocean with a single onslaught of moves. The forces of nature begin to activate their true power, combining their respective abilities to create a portal that freezes Undella Bay and a portion of a nearby city, where [[Officer Jenny]] wonders what is taking place. At the ruins, [[Dr. Zager]] comments to the others that this is what the ancient people fought over: the ability to unleash a neverending wave of natural disasters. The heroes' Pokémon burst from the ice to continue the battle, while at the same time, Ash reaches the top of the ruins again. He confronts Giovanni, who dismisses his challenge. Jessie and James call forth Woobat and Yamask again, but when Ash orders Pikachu to use {{m|Electro Ball}} against them, it turns into a gigantic, supercharged version of the move as a result of the excess energy from Thundurus's earlier attack. Electro Ball ends up obliterating the top of the temple, freeing Meloetta from its restraints and sending Team Rocket and the Reveal Glass flying right off. However, Giovanni gets completely overcome when he accidentally looks into the glass, causing him to scream in pain when the Reveal Glass blasts a beam of light right into his face. Unfezant recovers Meloetta and brings it to Ash, but Jessie, James and {{MTR}} demand he return it. Giovanni suddenly interrupts them and says they no longer need Meloetta, but as he stands up amidst the rubble, he is shown to have completely red eyes and a glowing symbol from the Abyssal Ruins on his forehead. Ridley, Iris, {{an|Cilan}} and Cynthia arrive, and Ash gives Meloetta to Ridley, but then warns his friends that the battle is not yet over. While the forces of nature overwhelm the heroes' Pokémon, Giovanni rises up and shouts that his goal is destruction. This horrifies his subordinates; James tries to remind him that their goal is to conquer, and in response to Meowth's question, Dr. Zager admits that he has no idea what is happening. Giovanni calls the forces of nature to his side and commands them to destroy all of Unova. Dr. Zager speculates that losing Meloetta may have caused Giovanni's condition, and Ridley confirms this, explaining that the three Legendary Pokémon control the power of nature and Meloetta acts as a balance on that power. With that balance no longer in place, Giovanni's sanity has been consumed by his own ambitions, turning his goals to destruction and chaos. Rejecting this, Jessie, James and Meowth leap toward Giovanni and shove him outside of the area of the temple's influence, releasing him from its control. They help him up, and he wonders what happened, having no recollection of what took place while he was possessed. Dr. Zager tells him they cannot control the Legendary Pokémon without Meloetta and recommends they retreat, which Giovanni agrees to. When Ash calls to them and asks where they're going, James merely has Yamask use {{m|Haze}} to provide cover. Team Rocket return to their jet and fly off, with Jessie and James remarking that Pikachu truly is special after all. The heroes' Pokémon continue fighting the forces of nature. Ridley returns the Reveal Glass to its pedestal, tells Meloetta they must stop the rage of Landorus and the others, and asks the Reveal Glass to grant him his wish. The Reveal Glass releases a gentle light that wraps around Meloetta as the [[Mythical Pokémon]] begins to sing. Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus calm down and stop fighting, then approach the Reveal Glass, which turns them back to their Incarnate Formes and ends the conflict. Aboard the Team Rocket jet, Giovanni reflects upon how his own ambitions nearly brought about his demise, then orders a return to {{an|Team Rocket HQ}} in [[Kanto]]. With the crisis at an end, the forces of nature fly off peacefully. The Abyssal Ruins sink back beneath Undella Bay, taking the Reveal Glass with them. That evening, the group bids farewell to Ridley and Meloetta. {{AP|Oshawott}} cries at the prospect of having to say goodbye to his crush, but he is comforted by Pikachu and [[Iris's Axew]] as Ridley and Meloetta fly away on Golurk. ==Major events== * {{an|Giovanni}} successfully summons the {{an|forces of nature}} and uses the [[Reveal Glass]] to turn them into their {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Forces of nature|Therian Formes}}. * {{TP|Iris|Dragonite}} begins to fully [[obedience|obey]] {{an|Iris}}, though his rogue attitude still remains. * {{an|Meloetta}} is freed from [[Team Rocket]]'s control and manages to calm down the forces of nature. * Giovanni withdraws Team Rocket (including [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}}) from [[Unova]] and returns to [[Kanto]]. * Meloetta leaves with [[Ridley]]. {{animeevents|BW}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Tornadus}} (Therian Forme) * {{p|Thundurus}} (Therian Forme) * {{p|Landorus}} (Therian Forme) ==Characters== ===Humans=== [[File:Dare da BW097.png|200px|thumb|right|{{tt|Dare da?|Who's That Pokémon?}}]] * {{Ash}} * {{an|Iris}} * {{an|Cilan}} * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] * [[Officer Jenny]] * {{an|Giovanni}} * {{an|Cynthia}} * [[Dr. Zager]] * [[Jervis]] * [[Ridley]] * [[The Protectors]] (flashback) ===Pokémon=== [[File:WTP BW097.png|thumb|right|200px|Who's That Pokémon?]] [[Who's That Pokémon?]]: {{p|Persian}} ''(US and international)'' {{p|Landorus}} (Therian Forme) ''(Japan)'' * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Axew}} ({{OP|Iris|Axew}}) * {{p|Unfezant}} ({{OP|Ash|Unfezant}};
